_comment: Pre-registered 2026-11-24, after my 60 tuning labels (commit e926b963) and before any held-out label existed. Each change alters exactly one value, in memory only (experiment.py). Proposed by Claude from my tuning labels; adopting any of them is my decision and would be a new FILTER.md version.

changes.object: a setting (the score threshold, FILTER.md section 4)
changes.why: Tuning row 39 (OpenAI b398e1c6, Backend Software Engineer, Applied Foundations) scored 55 and my hand label is 'should have been kept for review'. Tuning rows 4 and 5 also score 55, and my labels for both are 'correct reject', so the tuning labels already point both ways.

changes.object: the filter file (Rule 1, Step 4: a related title needs Rule 2 topics)
changes.why: Tuning rows 55 and 60 are related titles kept in review on a single topic phrase ('model evaluation', 'agentic systems'), and my labels for both are 'should have been rejected'. Tuning row 59 is also a related title with one topic, and my label is 'correctly in review', so this change would also undo a decision I agreed with.

changes.proposed_by: Claude, while building the shortlist claim checker
changes.why: Anthropic postings use the heading 'Strong candidates may also have', which Version 1.1 does not treat as preferred, so a year count under it could be read as mandatory. Not found through my labels.
